title: Ski Tracks Run Max Speed Leaderboard
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skitracks:run max_speed_kph=*
| stats sum(max_speed_kph) as total_value, avg(max_speed_kph) as avg_value by trail_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks trail values by total and average max speed across Ski Tracks run events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `max_speed_kph` values for each Ski Tracks run event and review total and average max speed by trail.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total max speed.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which trail shows the biggest max speed numbers in your Ski Tracks run data.
